q1_issues.issue: 'vertical expression' is fused into a compound kind although the modifier is incidental/poetic description rather than a classifier naming a recognized kind.
The Of argument hangs an individual witness (sk_desire_1) off a kind symbol, mixing the kind and individual levels the instruction set otherwise keeps apart.

q2_gaps: verbless colon definition ('Dancing: <NP>') — an equative with no copula and no clause
definitional identity with a definite description ('X is THE Y of Z') — no identity head exists, so it can only be approximated by Inheritance/subsumption
notes: The reduced relative 'legalized by music' is handled per the instruction set (event form, by-phrase to Agent), though its attachment to 'expression' rather than the nearer 'desire' is a choice the sentence does not settle. The indefinite witness for 'a horizontal desire' and the empirical 0.9/0.9 on the definitional claim are right.
